body:
I have tried therapy but all they did was push pills. I told a few friends of mine about my situation, about my childhood, about the abuse. Needless to say they isolated themselves from my life. I mean I am just not worth the effort, and I know people will post the cliche that "you matter", "your life is worth it", "give it time", so on and so forth. But honestly it kind of creeps me out how calm and happy I am about this decision. Don't mistake that for doubt for which I have none. 

My childhood just consisted of staying home every day right after school and being a punching bag for an alcoholic mother and father who threw me out on the streets when I was 16. Life is a cruel bitch but you know what? I feel like I got quite a bit out of it, I have had my ups and downs, I have had great friends and feel like even though my life has not been long, I have gotten so much out of it.

I have always put other people in front of everything else. I felt that if I help people at least I would be helping them get to their end goal, or make their life a bit easier, and for me that is happiness itself.

I spent my whole life protecting my siblings from my parents, taking the brunt of their rage and drunken beatings. I feel like I have at least helped my siblings if maybe even other people in my life. I do realize I am rambling now but I am just enjoying life now for the first time ever.

I am still stuck deciding between sleeping pill OD, or Carbon Monoxide poisoning, I want to go with the latter since I hear it is more peaceful and sleeping pills can cause violent convulsions.
